Amendements 23 Latn f Reraipt File No --- Page 5 --- KA RITI (CONSTITUTION) JONG KA SHNONG MADANRTING MYLLIEM SYIEMSHIP : KA LAMPHANG Ma ngi ki nongshong shonong shongthaw ka shnong Madanrting, kiba long ruh ki khun Khasi-Pnar, haba ngi la pyrkhat sani bha bad bishar bniah ia la ka jong ka shnong ka thaw ha baroh ki liang, ngi sngewdei ba ngin teh ia lade ha ki dustur bad rukom pyniaid shnong khnang ba ngin lab ban iaid shaphrang ha ki liang baroh khamtam eh ha ka Imlang sahlang. Kumta na ka bynta ka jingryntih ka shn- ong ka thaw bad ki jingmanbha kyllum jongka, ngi thaw bad sain dur ia kane ka Riti ba kan long ka jingteh ia ngi bad ki pateng jongngi.

ARTICLE I Ia kane ka ‘RITI' yntip kum ka RITI KA SHNONG MADANRTING. shnong Madanrting. Kane ka RiTI kan treikam naduh kata ka sngi ba ka dorbar shnong ka sngewdei ban buh tarik ba kan trei kam ARTICLE II Kine harum ki long ki jingbatai ktien kat kum kane ka Riti Madanrting. ka mut ka dorbar ki longsan ne ka Executive Com- mittee ka shnong Madanrting.

(c) "Ka Dorbar U Rangbahshnong" ka mut ka Dorbar ulong u nong pyniaid jongka hapoh ka shnong Madanrting. --- Page 6 --- (d) "Fund Shnong"' ka mut ka pisa tyngka jong ka shnong Madanrting. kum ka Constitution ka Ri India. (f) ‘Trai shnong nong-shong shnong" ka mut :-- (i) Uno uno u Khasi-pnar uba la kha ha shnong Madan rting uba da shong shnong shong thaw haka bad uba shim bynta ha ki kam shnong kam thaw.

(ii) Uno uno u shongkha uba long u khun Khasi- Pnar ha shnong Madanrting. -Buf ry ei rl op eqey su! eyin ey .sul !eda, (a) pyniaid bad la ka jong ka jingshet jingtiew. Kum ka nongmuna, ha kawei ka ing don saw kamra ba'a shong da ki sawkynrad, kumta man la ka kamra kadeika Dpei Ing.

ARTICLE III U PUD U SAM : U Pud synshar kha dar ka shnong Madanrting u long kumne : Na Lum Khyllon u pud u suh sha kjat RamSah bad na Sohphoh-dkoh u suh sha mynsiagn Lawjynriew. Na mynsain Lawjynriew u suh sha ..Dem hring (Na Demthring u suh sha mynsain Khyriem bad Kharkongor ia shem bad ka surok Shillong-Jowai (pyrshah skul Basic Madanrting) nangta u suh sha Bandstand bad ia kynduh bad ka Surok Happy- valley (kaba sharum) bad suh ter ter sha Wah-tipthoh. Na Wah-tipthoh sha Assam Rifle bad na Assam Riffe sha Um- khen tad shs lum Khyllon. ARTICLE IV Kine harum ki, long ki Dorbar pyniaid kah pyniaid jain' hapoh ka shnong Madanrting :-- --- Page 7 --- Dorbar Shnong : Kane ka long ka bor kaba ha khlieh duh ha ka jing pyniaid ia ki kam ki jam ka shnong.

Dorbar ki Longsan lane ka Executive Committee : Kane ka long ka bor kaba kham hapoh ka Dorbar Shonong Dorbar u Rangbah-shnong : Kane ka long ka bor bishar kam bishar jam ha shnong Madanrting ha kaba u Rang- bahshnong u long u khlieh nongpyniaid jongka. Ka jinglongdkhot, ka bor trei kam bad ki kamram jong kitei ki Dorbar kin long kat kumba la kdew ha ki article kiba bud. ARTICLE V DORBAR SHNONG : 1.

Ym judon ha ka riti dustur khasi ba ka kynthei briew kan long ka dkhot bad nongiashimbynta ha kaDorbar Shnong. Kumta ka Dorbar shnong kan kya hup tang ia kine harum. (i) Baroh ki Rangbah Nongkitkam ba la jied da ka Dorbar Shnong. (i) Baroh ki Rangfiah Nongmihkhmat sha ka Executive Committee ba la jied da ka Dorbar shnong ne ka Executive Committee.

(ini) Uwei pa uwei u khmat Rangbahyna kawei pa [kawei Khasi-pnar bad uba la palat ia ka 18 (Khadphra) snem ka rta la u long u traishnong non gshong shnong ne nongshongwai ha shnong. Ka Dorbar shnong kan kynthup ar rukom ki Dorbar kumne harum : (i) Ka Dorbar ba shisien shisnem bad ki kam jongka kiong lkumne : (a) Ban jied ia ki Rangbah Nongkitkam ka shnong (b) Ban jied ia ki Rangbah Nongmihkhmat she kt Executive Committee. (c) Ban tuklar ia ka report trei kam bad jinakheix jingdiah ka Executive Comimittee. --- Page 8 --- (d) Ban bsuh, weng ne thaw thymmai ia kano kano ka kyndon jingteh ha ka Riti Shnong lada donkam.

(e) Ban thaw ki lad ki lynti kumno ban pynheh ia ka Fund Shnong. (f) Ban thung ia ki Committee na ka bynta kino kino ki kam lada donkam. (g) Banuklar ia kino kino ki kam ba wan rah ka Executive Committee. (h) Ban tuklar ia kino kino ki kam ba wan rah ka Dorbar u Ran bah Shnong.

Ban tait shnong ia uno uno ne kano kano ka briew uba ne kaba , ka jingleh jong u ne jongka ka long kaba pyrshah ne mynsaw ia ka imlang sahlang ka shnong ka thaw. Ban tuklar ia kiwei kiwei pat ki kam ia kiba ym shym la iohi lypa hangne lane kiba donkam na ka bynta jong ka imlang sahlang ka shnong baroh kawei. (i) Ka Dorbar Pyrkhat kam bad ki kam jongka ki long kumne : B n I h ia baroh ki kam ia kiba la kdew ha ka subsection (i) haneng lait noh ki clause (a)haduh (d). Ka Dorbar ia kaba la kdew kat kum ka Section 2(i) hane'g kan shong man u snem kata la kumno kumno ha u bna uba kut jong u snem trei kam.

Ka Dorbar ia kaba la kdew kat kum ka Section 2 (ii) haneng kan shong ha kano kano ka por ha kaba u Rangbahshnong lane ka executive Committe ki sngew- donkam ban khot ia ka. Uno uno u dkhot jong ka Dorbar Shnong ia uba la kdew kat kum ka Section 1 jong kane ka Article uba pep sha ka Dorbar shnong khlem ki daw kiba shnongnia yn pynshitom ia u da kaba shainkuna kne da kumwei pat kat kum ka jingpynshongdor bad jingsngewbit kata ka Dorbar ha kaba u pep. Yn ym pynlong Dorbar shnong ha ka sngi U Blei lane ka sngi (Sunday). la ki jingrai ne jingiakut baroh ha ka Dorbar shnong dei --- Page 9 --- ban thoh ha ka Bui (Register) ha kaba yn soi ne shon- kti da baroh kiba wan sha ka Dorbar.

Ka Executive Committee kan thaw ia ki lad shaphang 'ka rukom khot ia ka Dorbar shnong bad ban buh ia ka jaka ban pynlong iaka 9. Uμo uno u dkhot ka Dorbar shnong u bym lah'ban poi sha ka Dorbar shnong u donkam ban pyntip ryngkat bad ki daw kiba shongnia sha kito ki Nongmihkhmal sha ka Executive Committee na ka Block -ha kaba ki ki sheng. Uno uno uba wan sha ka Dorbar shnong udei baa shong haduh ban da wa ka Dorbar bad ban soi ne shon- kti hadicn ba la wai ka Dorbar.

Uno uno uba mih ne phet na ka Doiba khlem da iohbor na u Chairman y? khein ia u kum uba pcp sha ka Dorbar. 11 Ki Rangbah-nongmihkrmat na ki Block sha ka Execu- tive Committee ki dei ban shin ia ka kyrteng jong kita kiba dei ban wan sha ka Dorbarshnong nakaBlock shwa ban long ka Dorbar bad ban pyntip ha khmat' ka Doibar ia kito kiba pep khlem ki daw kiba shongnia [2 Uno uno uba krenbein, lehibein, pynwit, kren ki kticrr! sniew nc pynklumar ia ka Dorbar shnong yn pynshitom ia u ha kano kano ka rukom kat kum ka jingsngewbit katakaDoibarhi.

Uno uno uba wan sha ka Dorbar shnong udei ban koh- nguh ia ka j'ngpyniaid u Chairman bad lada u pyrshah ia kata yn niew bad pynshitom ia  kat kum ka Section 12 haneng. I4, Uno uno u dkhot jong ka Dorbar shnong u dei ban rah bad pynnoh u bai synniang Dorbar man ba long ka da ka Executuve Committee ,bad mynjur da ka Doibar. ARTICLE VI KA DORBAR KI LONGSAN NE KA EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE 1 Ka Executive Committee kan kynthup ia kine ki akhot harum :- (i) Baroh ki Rangbah Nongkitkam kat kum ka Article vII. --- Page 10 --- (ii) 6 (hynriew) ngut ki Rangbah Nongmihkhmat kata ar ar ngut na kawei ka Block ba la kdew kat kum ka Article XIII ia kiba la jied da ka Dorbar Shnong kat kum ka clause (b) Subsection 2(i) Article V.

(ii) Uwei u dkhot ia uba ynjied da ka Executive Com- mittee. Ki dkhot ka Execut've Committee kat kum ka Section 1 haneng kin noh ha ka kam 3 (lai) snem naduh ka sngi ba la jied ne thung ka Dorbarshnong/Executive Commi- ttee. Lah ruh ban jied pynthymmai biang ia ki lada ka Dorbarshnong/Executive Committee ka ibit. Ka Executive Committee kan long ka Nongbthah, Nong- aijingmut bad Nongiatrei ryngkat bad u Rangbahshnong ha ka jingpyniaid ia ki kam shnong kam thau.

Ka Executive Committee kan pyndep ruh ia kino kino ki kam kiba ka Dorbor shnong ka bthah ne pynkhamti ha ka. Ka Executive Committee kan ai (i) ka Report trei kam jongka kaba shisien shisnem (ii) ka Report jingkhein jing- diah jong ka Fund shnong ba la dep Audit sha ka Dorbar shnong ba shisien shisnem (Section 2 (i) Article V). Ka Executive Committee kan peit bad pyniaid ia baroh ki kam kiba iadei ha ka imlang sahlang ka shnong kum ka Umbam Umdih, Lynti syngkien shnong, ka shongshn- gain ka shnong ka thaw, ka koit ka khiah, ka Fund shnong, ki skul shnong, ki mar nongkynti ka shnong bad kiwei kiwei de kiba dei na ka bynta ka shnong ia kiba ym shym la kdew hangne. Ka Executive Committee ka lah ruh ban thaw ki kyndon jingteh (rule) kiba ym pyr- shah ia kane ka Riti na ka bynta ka jingroi bad jingiaid shaphrang jongki.

Ka lah ruh ban thung ki Committee ban peit bad pyniaid ia ki. Ka Executive Committee kan thung ia u Auditor u ban Audit ia ki jingkhein jingdiah ka shnong napdeng kito ki briew kiba la bit ban shong ne shimbynta ha ka Dorbar shnong tang ba umdei ban long u dkhot ka Ex- ecutive Committee. Un neh lai snem ha ka kam jongu thymmai biang ia u, lada ibit.
